original_target.title: The strong Markov property for continuum dynamical percolation
original_target.area: Probability, stochastic processes and critical phenomena

scope_comparison: The original Question11.10 asks the strong Markov property beyond ordinary Markov behavior. The later Liouville Theorem1.4 proves mixing, not the exact stopped identity for the stated exceptional-state absorbing extension. Generic Palomar continuous-path Feller-process libraries cannot be substituted for this explicitly non-Feller quad-crossing process. Static Voronoi crossings and near-critical monotone coupling are different dynamics.
